source: Master specification §17 (TOR benchmarks) and §3.3 / §18 concurrency figures; measurement definition proposed in clarification C-02 / C-17.
measurement: Server-side time from the first filter to the end of request processing (authentication, authorisation, business logic and database commit included; network and client excluded), read from the Server-Timing header. Client-side time is reported alongside. External services are not called by any scenario.

entry.basis: §17 Individual financial entry processing: within 5 seconds

read.basis: PROPOSED (C-02): §17 sets no figure for inquiries and portal pages; the 5-second entry target is applied

report.basis: §17 Standard financial report generation: within 60 seconds (request to ready, for report jobs)

batch.basis: §17 Batch financial processing: within 60 seconds for the agreed test workload (workload not yet agreed; the kit's workload is stated in each report)

portal.basis: §17 External portal capacity: 100 accounts, with 60 simultaneous-user testing

errors.basis: PROPOSED (C-02): §17 asks for error-rate thresholds but sets none. No 5xx responses at all, and at most 1% unexpected responses per target kind.

subSecondGoal.basis: §17 / Annex A: sub-second is an optimisation goal, not an acceptance criterion
